description: Example A2UI 'SeverityBreakdownChoicePicker' surface, emitted alongside a DefectResultsTable when a search or live BigQuery aggregation spans more than one severity_level or aircraft_model, so the user can narrow with one tap.
userQuery: How many Main Landing Gear defects do we have by severity?
toolCallSummary: query_bigquery_defects (3-legged OAuth, live BigQuery) returned a GROUP BY severity_level aggregation for component_category = 'Main Landing Gear'.
sql_query_used: SELECT severity_level, COUNT(*) AS defect_count FROM `PROJECT_ID.aerospace_quality.aircraft_defects` WHERE component_category = 'Main Landing Gear' GROUP BY severity_level ORDER BY defect_count DESC

a2ui_surface.prompt: Main Landing Gear defects by severity — tap one to see the underlying records

surfaceUpdate.data: <the a2ui_surface object above, inlined per the GE v0.8 inline pattern>

userActionExample.name: filterDefectResults
userActionExample.resultingAgentBehavior: Agent re-calls datastore_search_agent (or query_bigquery_defects) filtered to component_category='Main Landing Gear' AND severity_level='Critical', then emits a new DefectResultsTable surface with the 6 matching rows.

assistantText: Main Landing Gear has 74 recorded defects: 41 Major, 27 Minor, and 6 Critical. Tap a severity to see the individual defect records.
